module: Flowgraph node "Get Fog" (category provider, tags environment/tod). Reads the current fog parameters: outputs density (core_environment.getFogDensity) and atmosphereHeight (getFogAtmosphereHeight).
notes: legacyPins declares a rename fog -> density in _in while density is an output here (leftover from the Set Fog node); no effect.

work.desc: Every frame, writes the fog density and atmosphere height to the outputs.
